hero.subtitle: A free live webinar for adoptive and foster parents on why behavior is often a form of communication, and how attachment and connection support real healing.
hero.paragraph1: Parenting a child who has experienced trauma can be both rewarding and incredibly challenging. This presentation explores how early experiences shape attachment, why behavior is often a form of communication, and how trauma can influence a child's brain, body, and relationships.
hero.paragraph2: Participants will gain practical, trauma-informed strategies to better understand challenging behaviors, strengthen connection, and foster healing. The session also introduces the science of epigenetics, offering hope that safe, nurturing relationships can support resilience and positive change over time.
